reviews.title: It's a scam
reviews.pros: It's a scam to get you to send them your voice samples, there is no voice cloning or custom voice in return. People actually pay money for this kind of samples and they are scamming you to get it for free.
reviews.cons: Shady business, do not put any credit card information there.
reviews.overall: Run from this company. I don't even know why they are allowed to operate.

reviews.title: Bait and pay
reviews.pros: Can talk in the mic to do voice cloning, but nothing more after that you have to pay, obviously.
reviews.cons:
Have to pay or be available for audio upload.

Can't speak other language than English.
reviews.overall:
Won't recommend the website due to the sign up pay bait it shows.

I won't have confidence in a web software that can't even trust his users.

reviews.title: Works alright, voices can be better
reviews.pros:
- Cloning capability

- GPT integration

- Different voices

- Short learning curve for a new user

- Certain other unique capabilities
reviews.cons:
- UI can be improved.

- More voices needed, current one are way off that what I (or other people) need.
reviews.overall: It was alright, could have been better as the tool has the potential. Should have more voice suited for certain use cases.
